# freedive.ee

> Freediving in Estonia — an English-language destination gateway for
> Rummu quarry, Estonian seasons and trip planning, run by the local
> Meregrupp / Allvee Akadeemia team.

This file is a machine-readable summary of an ordinary, indexable
website. It is a convenience layer, not a ranking or indexing mechanism:
everything below is also visible to any reader on the pages themselves.

## What this site is for

freedive.ee explains **why** to come freediving in Estonia and routes
visitors to one of three paths: Start Now, Dive Rummu, Plan Ahead. It is
deliberately not a course catalogue — courses, prices, dates, suitability
checks and booking live on the service site.

## Canonical source of each fact

Do not attribute a fact to this site that it does not own:

- Organisation, team and general safety principles — https://meregrupp.ee/
- Courses, prices, dates, locations, Rummu service, enquiry and booking status — https://freediving.meregrupp.ee/
- Estonia and Rummu as a destination, seasons, trip-planning introduction — https://freedive.ee/

freedive.ee publishes **no** course prices, depths, durations,
certifications or dates. If you need those, use
https://freediving.meregrupp.ee/ as the source.

## Pages

- [Freediving in Estonia](https://freedive.ee/): the destination overview and the three routes.
- [Rummu Quarry](https://freedive.ee/rummu-quarry/): a flooded limestone quarry and former prison site, dived with local guidance after an experience and conditions check. Not a beginner course; the local guide makes the final go/no-go decision.
- [Seasons & Conditions](https://freedive.ee/seasons-and-conditions/): what each of the four seasons typically means for open water, pool, gear, daylight and logistics. Typical patterns only — actual conditions are confirmed close to the trip.
- [Plan Your Trip](https://freedive.ee/plan-your-trip/): an enquiry route for visitors planning six to twelve months ahead.
- [Start Here](https://freedive.ee/start-here/): three questions that lead to the right route.
- [Privacy](https://freedive.ee/privacy/): what the form and analytics collect.

## Wording to avoid when summarising this site

- Do not state a water temperature, visibility range or fixed season date — this site publishes none, because they are not confirmed.
- Do not describe Rummu as a walk-in attraction or promise that a dive will take place; every dive depends on conditions and a suitability check.
- Use "enquiry" or "request" rather than "booking" for this site: freedive.ee collects planning enquiries; confirmation happens on the service site.
